checks.rule: Every schema uses JSON Schema Draft 2020-12, has a stable $id and rejects additional top-level properties.
All relative schema references resolve to frozen contract files.
Plugin policy permanently forbids auto trade, formal CSV write, rule enablement, Runtime SQLite write, HOLD/MIDR change and publish.
All schedules and hooks are disabled.
No API path exposes publish, trading, position, rule enablement or arbitrary command execution.
All POST API operations require the local session security scheme.
Owner thesis approval records candidate disposition only and effective_change_applied remains false.
Ledger policy is JSONL append-only with hash chain; update, delete and truncate are forbidden.
Knowledge gaps cannot be resolved without evidence and cannot be resolved finally by a model actor.
Research debt cannot auto-resolve or auto-delete and overdue debt cannot change HOLD.
Research Health weights sum to 100 and RHS is separate from RQS and investment ICs.
Source policy forbids DefaultFill, unregistered knowledge-base input and model-driven tier upgrade.
Phase 1A contains no Python, OpenAI runtime, module implementation, Launcher or report integration.
Formal CSV, authority manifest, rule manifest and Runtime SQLite remain outside the contract write scope.
Contract manifest records SHA-256 for every frozen artifact except itself.

passCondition: All CRITICAL and HIGH checks PASS.
failureBehavior: Do not enter Phase 1B; preserve core war room and request Owner review.
